question: Can an eight-channel exact-W autonomous coordinate field reconstruct enough missing q10:q15 hidden state to beat the scalar nonlinear-Z head and the deployed native bank broadly out of fold?

fixed_recipe.base: frozen alpha=.75 native-J state; c8 replaces rather than retrains the scalar nonlinear-Z q-head
fixed_recipe.architecture: 50 -> 64 SiLU -> 64 SiLU -> six layer-specific 8-channel source heads
fixed_recipe.inputs: raw20 + alpha-J state A + local qJ + exact transported raw20 Z + normalized transported c8 message
fixed_recipe.loss: normalized endpoint channel-zero MSE plus fixed 0.05 normalized six-layer channel-zero anchor

comparators.measured_native_authority: public_q24_native_transport_energy_final_v1/FINAL_FIT_RESULT.json and FINAL_MODEL.pt; recomputed per network during the frozen run
comparators.legacy_threshold_note: This is 0.9 times the P2R0F2D OOF scientific gate, not a measured native-bank score; it is intentionally an additional stricter check.

requirements: candidate relative OOF gain versus nonlinear-Z is at least 0.25 percent
at least three of four fold means improve nonlinear-Z
paired-network gain z is at least 2
at least 55 percent of networks improve nonlinear-Z
every fold has at least 50 percent network wins versus nonlinear-Z
the legacy protected40 OOF slice does not worsen
candidate OOF raw is strictly below the in-run recomputed same-688 deployed native bank
candidate OOF raw is strictly below 2.9672528546945005e-8
at least 55 percent of networks improve the measured same-688 native bank
candidate raw times the c8 D3 multiplier is strictly below D4 board #328622 adjusted 1.783621478716186e-8

outcome_law.scientific_pass_but_absolute_fail: persist a scientific model only; it is not submission-worthy
outcome_law.scientific_and_absolute_pass: persist a scientific model and prepare D3 integration, but require exact literal integrated FLOPs and target-free full gate before root packaging
outcome_law.scientific_fail: persist result only and close this exact c8 recipe
